description: This PHP source file defines the ConfigHelper class within the OrangeHRM project, responsible for managing configuration paths, plugin configurations, client settings, and global settings for the application.

classes.name: ConfigHelper
classes.description: A class that provides methods to retrieve and manage various configuration settings and paths for the OrangeHRM application.

methods.name: getPathConfigs
methods.description: Returns an array of key configuration paths based on the project directory structure.

methods.name: getPluginConfigs
methods.description: Retrieves plugin-related configurations, including plugin names, paths, and individual plugin configurations.

methods.name: getPluginConfiguration
methods.description: Fetches configuration details for a specific plugin given its directory.

methods.name: getClientConfigs
methods.description: Returns client-specific configuration settings, including directories for Vue build and templates.

methods.name: getGlobalConfigs
methods.description: Provides global configuration flags such as internationalization and session timeout settings.

methods.name: getConfigs
methods.description: Aggregates all configuration settings into a single array.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value by name, with an optional default.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Merges new configuration parameters into the existing configuration array.
